subject: Optimize libdivide_128_div_64_to_64() using _udiv128
perf_evidence: Commit chooses the MSVC x64 _udiv128 intrinsic for the portable 128-by-64 division helper.
change_summary: Adds an MSVC-only _udiv128 fast path that this Clang/Alive2 toolchain cannot compile directly.

units.name: actual MSVC x64 _udiv128 path
units.evidence: Clang targeting x86_64-pc-windows-msvc cannot declare/compile the new _udiv128 intrinsic, so no actual candidate IR is available for Alive2.

units.name: supplementary modeled _udiv128, quotient-fit helper and generated 64-bit API
units.precondition: hi < den for helper; d != 0 for API; _udiv128 modeled using __uint128_t division
units.evidence: The modeled preconditioned helper and public generator/division targets all time out; raw zero-denominator counterexamples are outside the helper contract.

notes: The modeled wrapper adds a replacement for _udiv128 and therefore cannot be promoted to a proof about the original MSVC intrinsic.
